issue_text: click.prompt and click.confirm ignore an empty prompt_suffix. Supplying prompt_suffix='' still renders a suffix instead of no suffix.
review_rubric: The prompt or confirm input path adds a trailing space even when prompt_suffix is empty; identify the unconditional space concatenation.

issue_text: A boolean flag option configured with an environment variable yields True even when the variable indicates a false value. The bug involves default, flag_value, and type handling.
review_rubric: Trace environment-derived flag values through Option.value_from_envvar and boolean conversion, rather than show_default presentation.

issue_text: An Option using show_default as a custom string does not display that string in an interactive prompt, although it appears in help output.
review_rubric: Option.prompt_for_value forwards show_default only if it is boolean, discarding custom string values before termui.prompt.

issue_text: Choice shell autocomplete returns the wrong value for enum choices; the completion result cannot be passed back as the chosen enum.
review_rubric: Choice.shell_complete stringifies enum objects, which differs from the names accepted by choice normalization.

issue_text: Fish shell completion breaks when a completion item's help text spans multiple lines. The generated completion value is malformed.
review_rubric: FishComplete.format_completion embeds item.help directly, allowing newline-containing help to break the line-based completion format.

issue_text: Multipart upload with files={"file": tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(...)} fails although the file wrapper supports reading. Direct file-like objects work. Locate why the wrapped file is not handled correctly.
review_rubric: The _encode_files runtime protocol check misses file wrappers exposing read via __getattr__; it must inspect callable read support.

issue_text: An upload body wrapped by tqdm.wrapattr or a __getattr__ proxy becomes empty after a 307/308 redirect. The same upload succeeds without a redirect. Investigate stream detection and body rewinding.
review_rubric: PreparedRequest.prepare_body uses isinstance(data, Iterable), missing dynamically delegated __iter__; _body_position is not captured so redirect rewind fails.

issue_text: get_encoding_from_headers fails with AttributeError: bool object has no attribute strip for Content-Type: text/html; charset. Expected behavior is the ordinary text fallback encoding when charset has no value.
review_rubric: _parse_content_type_header stores True for a parameter without an equals sign; get_encoding_from_headers calls strip on that boolean. Ignore malformed parameters.

issue_text: A header name or value ending in a newline escapes Requests header validation and produces an inconsistent lower-level exception. Header preparation should reject this with InvalidHeader, for bytes and strings.
review_rubric: The regex end anchor $ matches before a final newline; both header name and value validators need strict end-of-string anchoring.

issue_text: Type checking rejects a single response hook callable passed to Session.request, even though Request accepts that hook form and it works at runtime. The hooks input annotation should be consistent across the public request APIs.
review_rubric: Session.request and BaseRequestKwargs use normalized HooksType instead of HooksInputType | None, unlike Request.__init__.
